reason: A DeepSeek Harness workbench plugin that integrates a local terminal, code editor, workspace file management, Git controls, usage metrics, slash commands, and session notifications into a multi-column interface.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供集成编辑器、本地终端、文件管理、Git、用量面板、斜杠命令和会话通知的工作台界面。
summaries.en: An integrated DeepSeek Harness workbench with a code editor, local terminal, file management, Git controls, usage panels, slash commands, and session notifications.

capabilities: Runs commands through a local PTY
Performs Git operations including fetch, pull, push, staging, commits, branching, and merging
Uses AI assistance to translate natural-language requests into terminal commands
Displays API balance, spend, token, and context information
Plays configurable notification sounds and supports uploaded audio files
